headline: A 2014 law renames a Monroe, New York post office in honor of CIA officer Gregg David Wenzel.
what_it_does: This law names a United States Postal Service facility at 787 State Route 17M in Monroe, New York, as the National Clandestine Service of the Central Intelligence Agency NCS Officer Gregg David Wenzel Memorial Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014, and the naming applies from that date.
